studies.Title: Case-control study of urinary bladder cancer in metropolitan Nagoya.
studies.Reference: Case-control study of urinary bladder cancer in metropolitan Nagoya.

extraction_supporting_text.sample_size: The analysis, based on 293 patients and 589 controls who were frequency matched for age, sex, and residence, provided the following major findings.
extraction_supporting_text.cases: The incidence rates of bladder cancer were 2.42 and 7.05/100,000 for females and males, respectively. The analysis, based on 293 patients and 589 controls who were frequency matched for age, sex, and residence, provided the following major findings.
extraction_supporting_text.design: We conducted a population-based case-control study of patients with bladder cancer and of controls drawn randomly from the general population of Metropolitan Nagoya
extraction_supporting_text.ethnicity: controls drawn randomly from the general population of Metropolitan Nagoya
extraction_supporting_text.gender: Reduced risk of significance was suggested for the intake of black tea and matcha (powdered green tea) in females
